draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 71st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 10th of 36 at CB. He lasted until pick 130, well after his grade rank (71st): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Rasul Douglas. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (83rd percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (4th percentile). College production: 7 passes defended in 2023, 11th of 34 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens (reserve). 24 career games and 1 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 3.3% (93rd percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile), season snap share 13.0% (20th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 13.0% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, below the norm.
